notes.title: Day 1 Patch - 20/08/25
notes.content:
[p]This is the first patch for Once a Pawn a King![/p][p]
It's a quick fix to some of the issues players experienced on launch.
We are trying to patch every problem as quickly as possible! If you encounter any problems or bugs please reach out to us here on Steam or in our Discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/VsfGgQADMQ"]https://discord.gg/VsfGgQADMQ[/url] [/p][p][/p][h1][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]⚖️ BALANCE CHANGES ⚖️[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Winning a combat room now rewards players with 10 Inspiration[/p][/*][*][p]Capturing (killing) an enemy piece now restores 10 Mana[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]👾 [b]BUG FIXES[/b] 👾[/h3][list][*][p]Elite - Mini bosses no longer freeze when reaching the edge of the board[/p][/*][*][p]"Peas" Figure is working properly now (increasing army size)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor visual bugs[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p]We hope you guys enjoy this update - we're already working on the next one![/p]
